context: Small checker script in the canonical repo validating lock-vs-tree hashes and manifest-vs-lock coverage; wire as a required GitHub Actions check on PRs to main.
description: skill-sync-skills invariant (c) (docs/propagation.md) requires skill-sync.lock to be regenerated in the same commit as any skill edit, but nothing enforces it: PRs #9 and #10 merged skill edits (SHARED/commit-framework, SHARED/review-protocol) with stale lock hashes, silently breaking lock integrity on main until PR #11 repaired the instances. The class remains unguarded — the repo has no CI and no pre-commit hook. Add a mechanical gate (GitHub Actions job and/or pre-commit) that recomputes sha256/size for every lock entry against the tree, fails on mismatch, and fails on skills present in skill-sync.yaml but absent from the lock (the accidental-docs-drop class, instance-fixed in PR #11). Discovered 2026-07-29 during the docs-skill restoration.

preserves.behavior: Existing lock format and skill-sync CLI compatibility; Joe's identity on commits

verifications.command: sh -c 'cd /Users/joe/.skill-sync && python3 -c "import json,hashlib; from pathlib import Path; lock=json.load(open(chr(115)*0+chr(39)*0 or chr(0) if False else open) if False else json.load(open(chr(39) if False else chr(0)))"' ; false
verifications.description: lock hashes match tree on main
